execution_gate: Require current V24 source identity and exact reviewed plan bytes.
Require zero overlap with all completed, active, and pending coordinates.
Require the same campaign root and a new isolated stage root; do not create a new branch.
Run validate-only and compute with workers=3, batch_size=12, minimum_free_memory_mb=4096, and deliver_html=False.
Interpret only IMMUTABLE_CLOSED raw evidence and refresh the existing shared cumulative main and per-trade HTML.
stop_conditions: Stop on any source, plan, protected-set, lock, process, memory, or identity mismatch.
Do not refine E, BH, or S with continued single-digit absolute steps.
Classify every objective and block before proposing another round.
Keep gap-excluded return display-only and parameter_acceptance=none.
